notes.title: 03.08.2019 Steam Summer Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30716534/bda35e70bf8584e1902afb77d0f9c04f69b7c100.png[/img]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
      [*]Roster updates to reflect the 2019 football season (we will have another update after final cuts - late September 2019).
      [*]Added custom camera for Onside Kick. 
      [*]Added camera shakes after brutal tackles. 
      [*]Mayhem Bowl game mode is reintroduced to the game. 
      [*]Now players can turn on/off Arena Hazards, Weather, Dirty Tricks and Game Spectate in all game modes. Game Spectate is set to OFF by default.
      [*]Added new Leaderboards categories in the Dynasty game mode (Funds, Point Scored, Passing Yards, Receiving Yards, Rushing Yards, Interceptions, Kills, 2018 Season). 
      [*]Added Leaderboard for Online Game mode (Wins, Loses, Games Played). 
      [*]Now players can turn on/off notification "Someone is looking for an online Match", this option is set to ON by default.
[/list]

[h1]Changes & Improvements[/h1]

notes.title: MFL Longer Range Plans…
notes.content:
One of the things the MFL Team has tried hard to do is to involve our community with our future plans for the product early on. 
First, none of this happens if the game is not successful. You can help us make the game successful by promoting it through your social sites, by writing reviews and streaming.
Here is the direction we are heading over the next 6 months providing the game can generate enough revenue to allow us to do this:

[h1]Ports:[/h1]

Windows 10 Version
Develop a Switch Version
Develop a Mobile Version
Apple / Mac - TBD

[h1]Game Enhancements / Expansions:[/h1]

There are 2 routes we can go. One is to keep improving the game and move it towards a more competitive E-Sports structure, by allowing players to construct their own teams, rosters, playbooks and arena hazards with a balanced ratings system. The other is to create a Franchise / Story Mode where we can bring our characters to life. Our community has requested both of these major features over the last year. Both are solid features and directions for the game to go.

Initially, we want to create tools that allow Players to create their own content. Once that is in place we will be looking seriously into creating a story mode. This would be completely different than anything you’ve ever experienced in a sports game before. However, a story / franchise mode requires a deep narrative and universe creation, which requires time, the right people working on it and serious money to develop. We do want to develop this feature, but the property needs to prove itself worthy of this kind of investment first. 

For the immediate future we plan to focus on the following:

[b]Enhancements / Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] More Species (Demons, Werewolves, etc.)
[*] Online enhancements (co-op, 4 player, etc.).
[*] Improved Tackling Animations
[*] Season Improvements
[*] More Dirty Tricks
[*] Community Request / Feature development
[*] Graphical improvements
[/list]

[b]Sandbox Creation Tools:[/b]
[list]
[*] Team Editor (create your own team, name team, team colors, etc.)
[*] Play Editor (create your own plays and playbook)
[*] Arena Editor (name your arena, choose your field, hazards, etc.)
[*] Player Editor (Name players, pick species types, add ratings – with a balanced rating system – everyone has the same number of ratings points and how you allocate them amongst your players is up to you)
[*] League Structure with competitive leader boards
[/list]

So there you have it, these are the plans we have in place moving forward. If the game is successful we will certainly start building the brand into a viable property, and the best way to do that is through story development. 
Please let us know you like or disagree with the plan.

Concerning developing new games like Hockey or Soccer, etc. All of you, the MFL community will let us know what you want, and that’s what we will build, providing there are funds to allow us to develop a new game.

A lot is riding on this title, so please help us spread the word.

Thank you for your support!!!

The MFL Team.

notes.title: 10/19/2017 MFL STEAM UPDATE
notes.content:
Hi there! We've finally delivered another Steam update. And it has some major changes:

[h1]Game Speed[/h1]

Based on your feedback we've added Game Speed setting. It makes game faster or slower by changing some global attributes. You can switch it before each match in Team Selection screen (press X - Game Settings). We need your help to figure out what option should be default. Please, try it out and fill our survey:

[url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/RNZ7Y28]https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/RNZ7Y28[/url]

[h1]Keyboard Support[/h1]

Finally, MFL doesn't require a gamepad to play it. We've reworked all our UI and input system to add keyboard support. If you need help with keyboard bindings -  try use tutorial or go directly to the Keyboard Map screen. As always, your feedback on this feature is highly appreciated.

[h1]Other fixes and changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] More drama in Team Selection screen
[*] Rain VFX
[*] Various camera fixes
[*] AI fixes (timeouts logic, field goal logic)
[*] Various season UI fixes (schedule screen mostly)
[*] Now you have 20 seconds in online game to manage roster - after that clocks continue ticking
[*] Fix pause timer in online mode
[*] It was possible to play mini game 2 times in one game. Not anymore
[*] Fixed smack talk phrases after dirty trick play
[*] And many more less interesting fixes...
[/list]

notes.title: 10/5/2017 MFL STEAM UPDATE / CHANGE LIST
notes.content:
All the changes & fixes to the MFL Steam build on 10/5/2017. Huge thanks to our community for all the bug reporting and feedback to help us make the game better! THANK YOU!!!

[h1]Fixed (reported by community)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Consecutive bullshit penalties  
[*]Player is fainting after he breaks a tackle  
[*]Kill QB / Kill Referee don’t stop on Galaxy Chaos field 
[*]Wrong mini-game VO if player dies because of land mine 
[*]Kicker position on kickoff after penalty. Now he is always in the middle of the field
[*]Dead players not having a tombstone 
[*]The "Fake Kick Rollout" pass play doesn't bring up receiver icons 
[*]Teams' ratings differ slightly between Play Now and Season/Playoffs 
[*]Missing referee on a field 
[*]PAT moving to the next quarter after half time, thus breaking kickoff 
[*]Timeout can stop Kill QB / Kill Referee dirty trick 
[*]Announcer says wrong line if defense calls an audible
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved position synchronization in online game. Should be noticeable if ping <= 70
[*]Various framerate optimizations
[*]More game SFX
[*]Improved Crowd SFX (react more & louder in the playoffs)
[*]Buzz Saw / Spikes hazard delay – it doesn’t instantly pop-up
[*]Depth of field for smack talk cinematics
[*]Added collision to Mutant Worm - now he is dangerous
[*]Allow injured players be on a field if nobody else left, that means you no longer can forfeit because of injured players
[*]Added rock hazard
[*]Various tutorial / UI fixes and improvements
[*]Bench has new player categories
[*]Grim Bay Attackers Roster updated
[*]20+ Backer names added
[*]Tweaks and polish on difficulty settings (playing on rough is a bit easier now)
[*]Improvements to AI in final seconds of game (AI is smarter)
[*]Video Capture / Screen blood and numbers removed from options
[/list]

[h1]In Progress[/h1]
[list]
[*]Keyboard support
[*]Online mode improvements
[*]Less tutorial & tip messaging
[*]Leaderboards
[*]Onside Kick improvements
[*]More hazards and weather effects
[*]Team Tuning
[*]Stat Tuning
[*]Arena & Hazard polish
[*]SFX Improvements
[/list]
